name: Aegis (Path of Iron)
body:
Design creation [force]; Level 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

An invisible field of force surrounds the subject of an aegis script, providing a +2 armor bonus to AC. The aegis also negates magic missile and striking attacks directed at the target. Unlike mundane armor, aegis entails no armor check penalty, arcane spell failure chance, or speed reduction. Since aegis is made of force, incorporeal creatures can’t bypass it the way they do normal armor.

Overload: For each runic charge overloaded into this script, the armor bonus to AC increases by +1.
